ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportKontrahenciZGrupy' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportKontrahenciZGrupy;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportKontrahenciZGrupy] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @Typ_KntLinki int = 5122, @Typ_Knt int = 32
SELECT @rowVersion AS [@RowVersion] ,( select knl_GUID as [@GUID], KnG_GIDNumer as [@GroupId], kntGUID as [@CustomerGUID] from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.PobierzDrzewoGrupKontrahentow(PcK_KnGENumer,default) join cdn.KntGrupy on KnG_GIDNumer = AktuGidNumer and KnG_GIDTyp = -32 join cdn.Kntlinki on Knl_GroNumer = kng_gidnumer and knl_grotyp = kng_gidtyp and KnL_Lisc = 1 and knl_gidtyp = 32 join cdn.POS_KntDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) ON Knl_GIDNumer = kntGIDNumer and Knl_Gidtyp = @Typ_Knt join cdn.KntGrupyDom on KGD_GIDNumer = kntgidnumer and KGD_GIDTyp=32 and KGD_GrONumer = KnG_GIDNumer and KGD_GrOTyp = KnG_GIDTyp where psa_id = @PointOfSaleId for xml path('CustomerGroupMember'), type) for xml path('CustomerGroupMembers') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportKontrahenciZGrupy TO CDNRaport
